sentence: This project tries to find out what skills the fusion energy industry needs and builds a curriculum with virtual reality simulators.
This project studies how schooling behavior evolves in Neotropical tetras, using high-speed video recordings of the fish.
This project studies how very thin materials such as indium selenide change when exposed to light, heat, or strain.
This project studies how humans shape the land and how they solve environmental problems such as pollution and soil degradation.
This project studies materials for sustainability and quantum information, including sustainable polymers and Kagome metals.
This project builds fast software that searches through all the possible states of problems in the physical world.
This project builds a way to use remote quantum hardware without exposing sensitive data.
This project builds hybrid curricula, using virtual and augmented reality, for electric vehicle manufacturing and service work.
This project studies how protons and neutrons bind into atomic nuclei, using machine learning and quantum computing tools.
This project builds an optical tool that measures the mechanical properties of cancer cells and their surroundings without touching them.
This project builds and improves open-source software called Cardinal that simulates energy systems such as fission reactors and fusion power plants.
This project changes the teaching of materials engineering so that knowledge from one course carries into later courses.
This project holds a meeting where researchers share work on the mathematical principles behind artificial intelligence.
This project builds a way to rate design ideas, such as sketches and text, by combining human raters with machine learning.
